name: owned-module-boundaries
goal: Preserve helper definitions, callable contracts and dependency direction in owner-local modules

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Audit found mismatched private filenames and core forwarding imports into workflows. Runtime contracts must follow actual owner layers without losing callable exports or unit identities.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The migration ledger checked definitions and colocation but omitted split utility names and runtime entry contracts. Extend the frozen ledger and existing project detection tests with native cold-import checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test 7d14589d fails 31 canonical placement gaps and three owner-layer runtime assertions; immutable red 3519734beaf1c5921864ba7be66ea5d75e8a60db57459de1fbcb026686bba7c4.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Renamed split helpers to exported names; grouped initializer implementation helpers under owner-local lib folders. Core retains lower-layer definitions and types; registered internal runtime entries aggregate their callable APIs from workflows. Restored retired unit ownership.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
